frankenstein_2_design_delta: Preserve the out-of-model authority split, short lifetime, exact request binding, one-shot consumption and fail-closed denial semantics.

Replace raw shell-text authority with a typed EffectRequest and executor-consumed one-shot EffectDecision bound to invocation_id/tool_use_id, request_digest, session/generation/causal identity, policy version, resource identity and executor identity.

Keep ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, SUBMISSION_RECEIPT, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION, RESULT_REENTRY and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE as distinct typed states; later success must never synthesize earlier admission authority.

The sparse World Substrate capability chain and the real-effect authority chain may share one-shot/scope/expiry design ideas, but they remain separate capability classes: world-read cognition capability must never imply real-effect authority.
